company.name: Leonhard & Saalfrank GmbH & Co. KG
company.distributes: Raw materials and specialities for bakers, confectioners and ice cream makers, including spreads, sugars and frozen goods.
company.channels_supplied: Bakeries, confectioners and ice cream makers in north eastern Bavaria and Central Germany; Thuringia is implied by Central Germany but not named.
what_they_do_well: Family run wholesaler founded in 1924 offering over 6,000 lines to bakers and confectioners.
company.fit_rationale: Could place Diablo spreads, syrups and sauces with bakery and patisserie customers around Jena. A narrow, ingredient focused channel, so it is a conditional option.
